Game Overview

Lava Ladder Leap is a two-player game built around race against time and your friends in Lava Ladder Leap, a thrilling endless runner where you climb a castle tower, dodging traps and outrunning rising lava. Master strategic jumps and dashes to outlast competitors or the fiery threat below. Do you have what it takes to be the last one standing?
